1.title: A prayer for the straight path
1.context: The opening surah is itself a supplication; recited in every unit of the prayer
1.meaning: You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us along the straight path — the path of those You have blessed, not of those who earned Your anger, nor of those who went astray.
1.when: in every unit of the obligatory and voluntary prayer; in illness (the hadith call it a cure); at the start of any undertaking.

2.title: Admitting the limits of one's knowledge
2.meaning: Glory be to You! We know nothing except what You have taught us. Truly You are the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
2.when: before study and wherever your knowledge falls short; as an admission of your own limits.

3.title: For a safe city and provision for its people
3.context: The supplication of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) for Mecca
3.meaning: My Lord, make this a land of safety and provide its people with fruits — those of them who believe in Allah and the Last Day.
3.when: for the safety of your city, country and home; for the wellbeing of your neighbours.

4.title: That the deed be accepted
4.context: Ibrahim and Isma'il while raising the Kaaba
4.meaning: Our Lord, accept this from us. Truly You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
4.when: on finishing any act of worship — prayer, fasting, charity, work.

5.title: For one's own submission and that of one's descendants
5.meaning: Our Lord, make us submissive to You, and from our descendants a community submissive to You. Show us our rites of worship and accept our repentance. Truly You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.
5.when: during the Hajj; for children and grandchildren; when turning to faith.

6.title: For a messenger to be sent to one's descendants
6.meaning: Our Lord, raise up among them a messenger from themselves, who will recite to them Your verses, teach them the Book and wisdom, and purify them. Truly You are the Exalted in Might, the All-Wise.

7.title: Istirja — at loss and calamity
7.context: The words of those who are patient
7.meaning: Truly we belong to Allah, and to Him we shall return.
7.when: on news of a death and at any loss — of health, property, work or hope. The Qur'an promises blessings and mercy for it (2:157).

8.title: Good in both worlds
8.context: The most frequently recited supplication of the Qur'an
8.meaning: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
8.when: during tawaf between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone; after the prayer; at any time. By the Sunnah, the supplication the Prophet ﷺ made most often.

9.title: For patience, firmness and victory
9.context: Talut and his army before Jalut
9.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.
9.when: before a hard trial, an examination, a confrontation; when your strength is running out.

10.title: Asking to be shown a sign
10.meaning: My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead.

11.title: "We hear and we obey"
11.meaning: We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness we ask, our Lord, and to You is the return.

12.title: For a lightened burden and forgiveness
12.context: The closing verse of Surah al-Baqarah
12.meaning: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not lay on us a burden like the one You laid on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
12.when: every evening (by the hadith, the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah protect whoever recites them at night); when weighed down by a mistake; when circumstances feel unbearable.

13.title: For a steadfast heart
13.meaning: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Truly You are the Bestower.
13.when: in doubt about one's faith; in a setting where faith is under pressure; daily, as a request for constancy.

14.title: On the Day of Gathering
14.meaning: Our Lord, You will gather mankind on a Day about which there is no doubt. Truly Allah does not break His promise.

15.title: Forgiveness and refuge from the Fire
15.meaning: Our Lord, we have believed — so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
15.when: in the last third of the night (the Qur'an says the righteous seek forgiveness before dawn — 3:17).

16.title: "Owner of all sovereignty" — for authority, honour and provision
16.meaning: Say: "O Allah, Owner of all sovereignty! You give sovereignty to whom You will and take it away from whom You will. You honour whom You will and abase whom You will. In Your Hand is all good; You are able to do all things. You cause the night to enter the day and the day to enter the night, You bring the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living, and You provide for whom You will without measure."
16.when: for work, an appointment, a position of responsibility, one's dignity; when asking for provision (rizq); when in awe of the powerful.

17.title: A vow and a dedication
17.context: The wife of 'Imran, expecting a child
17.meaning: My Lord, I have vowed to dedicate to You alone what is in my womb. Accept it from me. Truly You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

18.title: Protecting a child from Satan
18.meaning: And I seek Your protection for her and her offspring from the accursed Satan.
18.when: after the birth of a child and for children generally (the wording changes with gender: u'idhuhu for a boy, u'idhuhum for several).

19.title: For righteous offspring
19.context: Zakariyya (peace be upon him) in the sanctuary
19.meaning: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Truly You are the Hearer of supplication.
19.when: for children; in infertility; that one's children grow up righteous.

20.title: "Write us among those who bear witness"
20.context: The disciples of 'Isa (peace be upon him)
20.meaning: Our Lord, we believe in what You have revealed and we follow the messenger, so write us among those who bear witness.

21.title: For forgiveness, firmness and help
21.context: The supplication of the prophets' companions in battle
21.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.
21.when: when the hardship follows from your own mistakes and you need forgiveness and help at once.

22.title: "Allah is sufficient for us"
22.context: The words of the believers when they were threatened with the enemy
22.meaning: Allah is sufficient for us, and how excellent a Guardian He is!
22.when: in fear, under threat or pressure; when frightened with consequences. By the Sunnah, the words of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) when he was cast into the fire.

23.title: Reflecting on creation
23.meaning: Our Lord, You did not create this in vain. Glory be to You! Protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
23.when: while contemplating the sky, nature, the expanse of the night; on waking during the night.

24.title: On the disgrace of the Day of Resurrection
24.meaning: Our Lord, whoever You admit into the Fire, You have disgraced. And the wrongdoers will have no helpers.

25.title: Answering the call to faith
25.meaning: Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith: "Believe in your Lord" — and we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins, blot out our misdeeds, and take our souls in the company of the righteous.

26.title: "Grant what You promised and do not disgrace us"
26.meaning: Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Truly You do not break Your promise.

27.title: For a protector and a helper for the oppressed
27.context: The supplication of the weak and the persecuted
27.meaning: Our Lord, bring us out of this town whose people are unjust. Grant us from Yourself a protector, and grant us from Yourself a helper.
27.when: under oppression; in a forced move, flight or exile; when there is no one to stand up for you.

28.title: To be parted from the corrupt
28.context: Musa (peace be upon him) when his people refused to enter the holy land
28.meaning: My Lord, I have power over none but myself and my brother. So separate us from the defiantly disobedient people.

29.title: "Write us among the witnesses"
29.meaning: Our Lord, we have believed. So write us among the witnesses.

30.title: For provision sent down and a sign
30.context: 'Isa, son of Maryam (peace be upon him)
30.meaning: O Allah, our Lord! Send down to us a table from heaven that shall be a feast for the first and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us — You are the best of providers.
30.when: when provision is short; before a meal in hard times; in the shared need of a family or a community.

31.title: Turning one's face to the Creator
31.context: Ibrahim (peace be upon him) after rejecting the idols
31.meaning: I have turned my face to Him who created the heavens and the earth, inclining to the truth, and I am not among those who associate partners with Him.
31.when: part of the istiftah — the opening supplication of the prayer.

32.title: Dedicating one's whole life
32.meaning: Truly my prayer and my sacrifice, my living and my dying belong to Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. This I have been commanded, and I am the first of those who submit.
32.when: in the istiftah; at a sacrifice; as a daily renewal of intention.

33.title: The dua of Adam — the first plea for forgiveness
33.context: Adam and Hawwa (peace be upon them)
33.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. And if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we shall surely be among the losers.
33.when: at any sin and repentance — the pattern of repentance the Qur'an gives first.

34.title: "Do not place us with the wrongdoers"
34.meaning: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

35.title: For a just decision in a dispute
35.meaning: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, for You are the best of those who decide.
35.when: in a conflict, a lawsuit, a dispute, when justice is beyond human means.

36.title: For patience and to die in submission
36.context: Pharaoh's magicians, who believed and were sentenced to death
36.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and take our souls in submission to You.
36.when: in grave illness, in fear of death, under persecution for one's faith.

37.title: The repentance of Musa
37.context: Musa (peace be upon him) at the mountain
37.meaning: Glory be to You! I turn to You in repentance, and I am the first of the believers.

38.title: Remorse after a mistake
38.context: The people of Musa after worshipping the calf
38.meaning: If our Lord does not have mercy on us and forgive us, we shall surely be among the losers.

39.title: Forgiveness for oneself and one's brother
39.context: Musa (peace be upon him) about Harun
39.meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.
39.when: after a quarrel with someone close; for a brother, a sister, a friend.

40.title: "You are our Protector"
40.meaning: You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of forgivers. And decree for us good in this world and in the Hereafter. Truly we have turned to You.

41.title: Refuge from the whisperings of Satan
41.meaning: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed.
41.when: before reciting the Qur'an (16:98); in anger; at an evil thought; in fear.

42.title: "Allah is sufficient for me"
42.context: The words Allah taught His Prophet ﷺ
42.meaning: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
42.when: by the Sunnah, seven times in the morning and seven in the evening; when people have turned away; in anxiety about the future.

43.title: The supplication of the people of Paradise
43.meaning: Glory be to You, O Allah! …And the close of their call is: "Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds."
43.when: as the opening and closing formula of any gathering and any undertaking.

44.title: "Do not make us a trial"
44.context: The believers among the people of Musa
44.meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
44.when: when your weakness or fall risks becoming another's excuse for disbelief; when hounded for your faith.

45.title: A supplication against a tyrant
45.context: Musa (peace be upon him) against Pharaoh
45.meaning: Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts, so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment.

46.title: The supplication for setting out
46.context: Nuh (peace be upon him) on boarding the ark
46.meaning: In the name of Allah is its sailing and its anchoring. Truly my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.
46.when: when setting out on a journey, boarding a ship, a plane, a car.

47.title: On not asking for what one does not know
47.context: Nuh (peace be upon him) after asking about his son
47.meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from asking of You what I have no knowledge of. And unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I shall be among the losers.
47.when: when asking for something you cannot know to be good or ill; after a hasty or mistaken supplication.

48.title: "My success is only from Allah"
48.meaning: My success is only through Allah. Upon Him I rely and to Him I turn.
48.when: when beginning a task; on succeeding, so as not to claim it for yourself.

49.title: For protection from temptation
49.meaning: My Lord, prison is dearer to me than that to which they call me. And unless You turn their guile away from me, I shall incline to them and be among the ignorant.
49.when: under a temptation that pulls at you; when choosing between a sin and a loss.

50.title: Complaining to Allah alone
50.meaning: I complain of my anguish and my grief only to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.
50.when: in deep grief; when the urge is to complain to people.

51.title: To die a Muslim
51.context: Yusuf (peace be upon him) at the height of his success
51.meaning: My Lord, You have given me authority and taught me the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Protector in this world and the Hereafter. Take my soul as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
51.when: on reaching a goal, so as not to forget the Giver; as a prayer for a good end.

52.title: For safety and against idolatry
52.meaning: My Lord, make this city safe, and keep me and my sons from worshipping idols.

53.title: "You know what we conceal and what we declare"
53.meaning: Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we declare. Nothing is hidden from Allah, on the earth or in the heaven.

54.title: To establish the prayer — for oneself and one's descendants
54.meaning: My Lord, make me one who establishes the prayer, and from my descendants too. Our Lord, accept my supplication.
54.when: after the prayer; for children who do not pray.

55.title: Forgiveness for oneself, one's parents and all the believers
55.meaning: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning is established.
55.when: for parents, living and departed; at the end of a personal supplication, to take in the whole community.

56.title: A supplication for one's parents
56.meaning: My Lord, have mercy on them both as they brought me up when I was small.
56.when: daily for one's parents; after their death. For a single parent: Rabbi-rhamhu (father), Rabbi-rhamha (mother).

57.title: For a truthful entrance and exit
57.meaning: My Lord, let me enter with a truthful entrance and leave with a truthful exit, and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
57.when: when moving house, changing work, beginning and ending an important stage; on entering and leaving a city.

58.title: Takbir and praise
58.meaning: Praise be to Allah, who has taken no son, who has no partner in sovereignty, and who needs no protector out of weakness. So magnify Him greatly!

59.title: The supplication of the People of the Cave
59.context: Young men who took refuge for the sake of their faith
59.meaning: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and prepare for us right guidance in our affair.
59.when: at a hard choice; when the next step is unclear; when looking for work, a home, a spouse.

60.title: "Perhaps my Lord will guide me"
60.context: A command for speaking of the future
60.meaning: Perhaps my Lord will guide me to something nearer than this in rightness.
60.when: whenever speaking of the future — always with "in sha Allah"; and on forgetting, to remember Allah.

61.title: On seeing another's blessing — against the evil eye
61.context: The words the owner of the garden should have said
61.meaning: What Allah has willed! There is no power except with Allah.
61.when: on seeing something that pleases you, your own or another's; protection from envy and the evil eye.

62.title: Zakariyya's supplication for an heir
62.context: Zakariyya (peace be upon him) in old age
62.meaning: My Lord, my bones have grown feeble and my head is aflame with grey, yet never have I been unblessed in my prayer to You… So grant me from Yourself an heir, who will inherit from me and inherit from the family of Ya'qub. And make him, my Lord, pleasing to You.
62.when: for children late in life; when a supplication long goes unanswered — Zakariyya prayed for decades.

63.title: Refuge from someone who inspires fear
63.meaning: I seek refuge with the Most Merciful from you, if you fear Allah.
63.when: on meeting someone who frightens you or means you harm; when your honour is threatened.

64.title: Musa's supplication before a hard conversation
64.context: Musa (peace be upon him) before Pharaoh
64.meaning: My Lord, expand my breast, ease my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, so that they may understand my speech.
64.when: before a talk, an examination, negotiations, a difficult conversation; in fear of public speaking; with a stammer or nerves. One of the most practical supplications in the Qur'an.

65.title: On fear of an unjust man
65.context: Musa and Harun (peace be upon them)
65.meaning: Our Lord, we fear that he will hasten to harm us or that he will transgress.

66.title: For an increase in knowledge
66.context: The only supplication in the Qur'an asking for an increase
66.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge!
66.when: before study, reading, work on a hard problem; every day.

67.title: Ayyub's supplication in illness and affliction
67.meaning: Truly adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.
67.when: in illness, in pain, in a long trial. Note that Ayyub does not ask outright to be relieved — he only states his condition and recalls Allah's mercy.

68.title: The supplication of Yunus — Dhun-Nun
68.context: Yunus (peace be upon him) in the darkness of the whale
68.meaning: There is no god but You! Glory be to You! Truly I was among the wrongdoers.
68.when: in any situation with no way out. By the hadith, no Muslim supplicates with it for anything but that Allah answers him. The best-known supplication of despair in Islam.

69.title: "Do not leave me alone"
69.meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.
69.when: in loneliness; in childlessness; when there is no one to carry the work on.

70.title: For a just judgement
70.meaning: My Lord, judge in truth! Our Lord is the Most Merciful, whose help is sought against what you describe.

71.title: For help against one's accusers
71.meaning: My Lord, help me, for they have denied me.
71.when: when you have been slandered, unjustly accused, disbelieved.

72.title: Praise for deliverance
72.context: Nuh (peace be upon him) on the ark
72.meaning: Praise be to Allah, who has saved us from the wrongdoing people!
72.when: after deliverance from a calamity, an accident, an illness, an enmity.

73.title: For a blessed place — the supplication for a new home
73.meaning: My Lord, cause me to land at a blessed landing place, for You are the best of those who bring to land.
73.when: when moving, settling into a new home or a hotel, on returning from a trip.

74.title: "Do not place me among the wrongdoers"
74.meaning: My Lord, if You should show me what they are promised — my Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.

75.title: Against the promptings of the devils
75.context: One of the principal supplications of protection in the Qur'an
75.meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the promptings of the devils, and I seek refuge with You from their presence with me.
75.when: in intrusive thoughts, anxiety, sleeplessness, fear; before sleep; at the moment of anger.

76.title: Forgiveness and mercy
76.context: The supplication of the servants of Allah
76.meaning: Our Lord, we have believed. So forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of the merciful.

77.title: The short supplication for forgiveness — the last verse of the surah
77.meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful.
77.when: the shortest all-purpose supplication of the Qur'an — fitting at any moment.

78.title: For deliverance from the punishment of Hell
78.context: The supplication of the servants of the Most Merciful
78.meaning: Our Lord, turn away from us the punishment of Hell, for its punishment is relentless. Evil indeed it is as a settlement and a dwelling.

79.title: For a family — "the comfort of the eyes"
79.context: The chief family supplication of the Qur'an
79.meaning: Our Lord, grant us in our spouses and offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us an example for the God-fearing.
79.when: for marriage, a spouse, children; when hoping to start a family; for peace in the home.

80.title: Ibrahim's supplication — for wisdom, a good name and Paradise
80.context: The extended supplication of Ibrahim (peace be upon him)
80.meaning: My Lord, grant me sound judgement and join me with the righteous. Leave a good name for me among later generations. Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss. And forgive my father, for he was among those astray. And do not disgrace me on the Day of Resurrection.
80.when: lisan sidq — asking to be remembered well after you; and for wisdom in decisions.

81.title: For a decision between me and them
81.meaning: My Lord, my people have denied me. So decide between me and them a decisive decision, and save me and the believers who are with me.

82.title: To save one's family from bad surroundings
82.meaning: My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.
82.when: to protect a family from a bad environment, bad influence, the lawlessness around them.

83.title: Sulayman's supplication of gratitude
83.context: Sulayman (peace be upon him), on hearing the ant
83.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for the favour You bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You. And admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants.
83.when: on receiving a blessing — success, income, recovery; so that gratitude is not forgotten.

84.title: The repentance of Bilqis
84.meaning: My Lord, I have wronged myself, and I submit with Sulayman to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

85.title: Musa's supplication after a mistake
85.context: Musa (peace be upon him), having killed a man unintentionally
85.meaning: My Lord, I have wronged myself. So forgive me!
85.when: immediately after a wrong you have done. The Qur'an notes that Allah forgave him at once.

86.title: A vow never to aid the criminal
86.meaning: My Lord, for the favour You have shown me, I will never be a supporter of the criminals.
86.when: when offered a part in a dishonest affair.

87.title: For deliverance from the unjust
87.context: Musa (peace be upon him) leaving Egypt
87.meaning: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people!
87.when: under pursuit, under threat, in flight.

88.title: The supplication of the destitute and the homeless
88.context: Musa (peace be upon him) in Madyan — with no money, no home and no protection
88.meaning: My Lord, truly I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
88.when: in poverty, unemployment, homelessness, complete uncertainty. The answer to this supplication was shelter, work and marriage.

89.title: For help against the corrupt
89.meaning: My Lord, help me against the corrupting people!

90.title: For a righteous child
90.meaning: My Lord, grant me a righteous child!
90.when: for a child; short and exact — the request is not for a child as such but for a righteous one.

91.title: The closing glorification
91.meaning: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they ascribe. Peace be upon the messengers! And praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds!
91.when: by the Sunnah, the close of a gathering and the close of a supplication.

92.title: Sulayman's supplication for sovereignty
92.meaning: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom that will not befit anyone after me. Truly You are the Bestower.

93.title: Ayyub's supplication about the harm of Satan
93.meaning: Truly Satan has touched me with weariness and torment.
93.when: in exhaustion, loss of strength, low spirits, the sense of harm coming from outside.

94.title: For the settling of disagreements
94.meaning: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen! You will judge between Your servants concerning that in which they differed.
94.when: by the Sunnah, the Prophet ﷺ opened the night prayer, tahajjud, with these words; in disagreement and division.

95.title: The angels' supplication for the believers
95.context: The bearers of the Throne pray for mankind
95.meaning: Our Lord, You encompass all things in mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the punishment of the Blaze. Our Lord, admit them into the Gardens of Eden which You promised them, and the righteous among their fathers, spouses and offspring. Truly You are the Exalted in Might, the All-Wise. And protect them from evil deeds.
95.when: as a supplication for all the believers, for one's family, for the departed.

96.title: Entrusting one's affair to Allah
96.context: The believer from the household of Pharaoh
96.meaning: I entrust my affair to Allah. Truly Allah sees His servants.
96.when: when you have done all you can and the outcome is out of your hands; in fear of the consequences of an honest act.

97.title: The supplication for travel
97.meaning: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have achieved it ourselves. And truly to our Lord we shall return.
97.when: on getting into a car, a plane, a train — the standard supplication for travel in the Sunnah.

98.title: For relief from a calamity
98.meaning: Our Lord, remove the punishment from us, for we are believers!
98.when: in a shared calamity — an epidemic, famine, war, drought.

99.title: The supplication of maturity — at forty
99.context: The supplication of one who has reached forty years
99.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for the favour You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You. And make my offspring righteous. I turn to You in repentance, and I am among those who submit.
99.when: for children and parents at once; in middle age; when taking stock.

100.title: The supplication of the overcome
100.meaning: I am overcome, so help me!
100.when: when your strength is gone and you have nothing left to defend yourself with.

101.title: For a heart clean towards the believers
101.context: The supplication of those who came after the first Muslims
101.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith. And put no rancour in our hearts towards those who have believed. Our Lord, truly You are Kind, Merciful.
101.when: when hurt by another Muslim; in a split within the community; for the generations before you.

102.title: Reliance and turning to Allah
102.meaning: Our Lord, upon You we rely, to You we turn, and to You is the return.

103.title: "Do not make us a trial for the disbelievers"
103.meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord. Truly You are the Exalted in Might, the All-Wise.

104.title: For light on the Day of Resurrection
104.meaning: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. Truly You are able to do all things.

105.title: The supplication of Asiyah — for a house in Paradise
105.meaning: My Lord, build for me a house near You in Paradise, save me from Pharaoh and his deeds, and save me from the wrongdoing people.
105.when: in a hard marriage or family; under violence at home; when leaving is not physically possible. Asiyah asked for the nearness before the house — 'indaka (near You) comes before baytan (a house).

106.title: Nuh's supplication against those who persisted
106.meaning: My Lord, do not leave upon the earth a single dweller from among the disbelievers!

107.title: Forgiveness for parents, household and all the believers
107.meaning: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and women.
107.when: for parents, household, guests and the whole community at once.

108.title: Surah al-Falaq (113)
108.meaning: Say: "I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak from the evil of what He created; from the evil of darkness when it settles; from the evil of those who blow on knots; and from the evil of an envier when he envies."
108.when: three times morning and evening; before sleep (wiping over the body, as in the Sunnah); in illness, the evil eye, sorcery, envy.

109.title: Surah an-Nas (114)
109.meaning: Say: "I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind."
109.when: three times morning and evening; in intrusive thoughts, anxiety, doubts about faith, fear of people.
